name: Joe Walsh
summary:
William Joseph Walsh (born December 27, 1961) is an American politician, talk radio host, former social worker, and 2020 Republican Party presidential candidate who represented Illinois's 8th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013. He left the Republican Party in 2020 to become an independent before registering as a Democrat in 2025, then becoming an independent once again in 2026.
Born and raised in the Chicago metropolitan area, Walsh began his career as a social worker providing education and job skills training to students in low-income areas, gradually becoming more politically active.
